families.keys: Keys - the two dimension keys the pack adds (the other tiers reuse existing items); each is used up opening its dimension
families.foci: Foci - Ars Nouveau Enchanting Apparatus products that gate the Other key and the catalyst
families.shards: Shards - drops of the two planet ores, the Astral Focus inputs
families.ores: Ores - the two pack blocks, one on Mercury and one on Glacio

coin.role: The questbook currency, in the game today. Every quest pays a few; the Coin Shop chapter sells repeatable reward bags for them.
coin.earned: Quest rewards, a few per quest; the reward bags can drop some too.
coin.consumed: Coin Shop bag quests: 16 coins for a Common bag, 48 for an Uncommon bag. Rare bags arrive in v0.2, Epic and Legendary in v0.3.
coin.notes: Stack of 64, so it must read at 16 px next to a number. One dark C in the centre; keep it plain. Also the Coin Shop chapter icon.

twilight_key.role: In the game today (tier 2). The only thing that opens a Twilight Forest portal in this pack; the diamond trigger is disabled. Thrown into the water pool like the vanilla diamond, one key per portal.
twilight_key.earned: Crafted from a netherite ingot, Aether zanite, a Mekanism advanced control circuit, an Ars Nouveau essence and a Cataclysm Monstrous Horn.
twilight_key.notes: Green ramp = Twilight Forest. The bow's ring and the two teeth are the silhouette the Other key must keep.

other_key.role: Will be consumed at an Allthemodium Teleport Pad placed in the Nether to reach The Other, the tier-5 dimension (v0.3).
other_key.earned: Planned recipe (v0.3): a Vibranium ingot, a dragon egg, essence of the bees, an IF Advanced Machine Frame and an End Focus.
other_key.notes: Purple ramp = The Other. Same pixels as the Twilight key with the ramp swapped; change both keys together.

end_focus.role: The tier-4 magic composite: an Enchanting Apparatus product that will be an input of the Other key (v0.2).
end_focus.earned: Planned Enchanting Apparatus recipe (v0.2): four Ars essences, dragon's breath, a Gauntlet of Guard, a Ritual of Binding charm, a source gem block, a Planarium.
end_focus.notes: Dark purple gem (purple base / dark / deep) in a neutral frame. The frame is shared with the Astral Focus.

astral_focus.role: The last focus: the magic-side input of the Confluence Catalyst, and the reason the two planet ores exist (v0.3).
astral_focus.earned: Planned Enchanting Apparatus recipe (v0.3): Etrium, a divine soulshard, a Mercury shard and a Glacio shard.
astral_focus.notes: Pale gold gem in the same frame as the End Focus. Should look like the end focus's bright sibling.

confluence_catalyst.role: The pack's final item, to be made at the Ars Nouveau Enchanting Apparatus; every mod's creative-tier item will be rewritten to consume one (v1.0).
confluence_catalyst.earned: Planned recipe (v1.0): Etrium, the three Allthemodium alloys, a dragon egg, an Astral Focus, an AE2 wireless receiver and an AE2 crafting unit.
confluence_catalyst.notes: The signature texture and the pack's logo-in-waiting: three streams (ice = tech, purple = magic, green = exploration) meeting in an ember core. The only texture allowed four ramps. Spend your effort here first.

mercury_shard.role: Dropped by Mercury Ore (the block already drops it); one of the two Astral Focus inputs, and nothing else will make it.
mercury_shard.earned: Mining Mercury Ore on Mercury (Ad Astra) once the ore is placed there (v0.3).
mercury_shard.notes: Ember ramp. Same crystal as the Glacio shard; change both together.

glacio_shard.role: Dropped by Glacio Ore (the block already drops it); the other Astral Focus input, and nothing else will make it.
glacio_shard.earned: Mining Glacio Ore on Glacio (Ad Astra) once the ore is placed there (v0.3).
glacio_shard.notes: Ice ramp. Same crystal as the Mercury shard; change both together.

mercury_ore.role: Pack block that will generate only in Mercury's one biome, buried in small veins (v0.3; not placed yet). Drops Mercury Shards.
mercury_ore.notes: Fully opaque, tiles on all four edges (check the corners against each other). Neutral stone base, ember flecks each with their own outline. Same base as Glacio Ore.

glacio_ore.role: Pack block that will generate only in Glacio's two biomes, buried in small veins (v0.3; not placed yet). Drops Glacio Shards.
glacio_ore.notes: Fully opaque, tiles. Same base as Mercury Ore, ice flecks.
